To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) gamma radiation selectively inhibits maturation of ribonucleic acid (RNA) in the liver of intact and adrenally deficient rats; (2) 5-fluoro-2'-deoxyuridine (FUdR) administration alone or in combination with radiation produces an RNA maturation block in the liver of adrenally deficient but not intact rats; and (3) the response to radiation is influenced by the state of the adrenal glands.

the effects of ionizing radiation on the maturation of rRNA.
the effects of radiation on RNA metabolism in the rat liver.
the effects of irradiation and adrenalectomy on rRNA maturation.

the 45S rDNA precursor block in liver cells of rats exposed to ionizing radiation is a consequence of the inhibition of rRNA maturation and is influenced by the adrenal glands.
